import sys, json, time, resource, io
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1024**3, 1024**3))
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from formats import read_request
from pipeline import execute

releases=[]
nrel=8
per=512
for r in range(nrel):
    motifs=[[1515 + 20*((i >> (j % 9)) & 1) for j in range(16)] for i in range(per//2)]
    disc=[]
    for m in motifs:
        for _ in range(2):
            vals=[0]*24+list(m)+[0]*24
            disc.append({'class':0,'values':vals,'activation':[0]*24+[100]*16+[0]*24})
    validation=[]
    for k in range(1024):
        body=[]
        for t in range(8):
            body += motifs[(k*8+t) % len(motifs)]
        validation.append({'class':0,'values':(body+[1515]*128)[:128]})
    train=[{'class':0,'values':[1515]*16} for _ in range(1024)]
    releases.append({'id':'b%d'%r,'classes':1,'width':16,'eps':[1,1000],'ratio':[1,256],
        'threshold':[0,1],'mode':'exact','packet_limit':200000,'idle_us':10**12,
        'discovery':disc,'train':train,'validation':validation})
blocks=[]
ops=0
for r in range(nrel):
    blocks.append([['install','b%d'%r]]); ops+=1
nflow=8192; pk=200000//nflow; extra=200000-pk*nflow
for f in range(nflow):
    fid='f%d'%f
    block=[['open',fid]]; ops+=1
    ts=0
    for p in range(pk + (1 if f<extra else 0)):
        block.append(['packet',fid,ts,0,300+p%50]); ts+=1; ops+=1
    block.append(['close',fid]); ops+=1
    blocks.append(block)
while ops<218432:
    blocks[-1].append(['install','b0']); ops+=1
req={'capacity':{'range':4096,'exact':8192},'releases':releases,'blocks':blocks}
data=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('bytes',len(data),'ops',ops, flush=True)
start=time.time()
out=execute(read_request(io.BytesIO(data)))
print('clusters',[len(c['clusters']) for c in out['catalog']])
print('kept',[len(c['priority']) for c in out['catalog']])
print('entries',[c['entries'] for c in out['catalog']])
print('%.2fs rss=%dMB' % (time.time()-start, resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss//1024))
PYEOF
